eventName: Fifth Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Planting-eighth phase of field work
eventDescription:
A total of 5,000 palm seeds were planted during this event.
In this initiative, the Temple Administrative Officer Mr. Senthilkumar, the Panchayat President, the Temple Trustee Chairman and former leaders, Annachatthiram Mohan, Sasikumar, local villagers, and the students of the Walajabad Industrial Training Institute enthusiastically participated, contributing to this green effort for the growth of palm trees.
